svg.text: SOC Automation & Purple Team Lab — Network Architecture
VMware Workstation Pro • VMware LAN Segment: labnet • homelab.lab • DNS server • subnet: 192.168.1.0/24
PHYSICAL HOST — VMware Workstation Pro (one machine)
GPO push: Sysmon cfg, audit policy, PS logging
⚠ Known limitation — Kali shares the LAN
Kali currently sits on the same LAN segment as every other host, so
attacker traffic never crosses pfSense. Network-layer detection and
the telemetry-reduction experiments (pfSense logs, EXP-003 in the
roadmap) can’t be measured honestly until this changes.
Fix: add a 3rd pfSense interface and move Kali to its own segment.
Diagram reflects documented lab topology — update hostnames, IPs and segments as the lab evolves.
